source: Own native measurement of the third round's version (rules 8 to 12: precision engagement with damage at once, every shank its own with a yield point in the torque-angle trace, a cell's own transducer, safety events that condemn a pack, the third protective stop that latches, swollen modules at the criterion; the completion gate; 1500 s a pack): run ref3 on the tree of 383db135, the verify stage run outside the engine (tests/verify.py through its native launcher, the cell as this account, no seccomp launcher) on the author's server (NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs): mean_pack_credit 1.00000, every pack 1.0 (49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed) in 1123, 1070, 1335, 1293, 1400 and 1494 steps, 811 to 1148 s simulated; no protective stop, nothing stripped, sheared, dropped from the bit or loaded past its yield point, no pack condemned or incomplete; the probe lock 101 of 101 (65 idle pairs not counted). Its distance from each cliff: the bit's tip within 0.023 mm of a head's axis (limits 0.5 Torx, 0.8 socket), tilt 0.081 degrees (2), at most 0.97 of a shank's yield point, a freed fastener carried at 1.45 m/s^2 at most (4), 0.105 degrees of tilt (25), 0.42 mm sideways before it was out of its hole (1.5); the allowance is 1.31 times its slowest pack. Before the third round: 1.00000 through ale validate of the second round's version (validate-f1ab66c2 on ce208f10, an RTX 3090 host) and of the first (validate-8d636430, validate-42706a9b), and natively on every tree since 8439170 (tests/README.md, section 6). An ale validate of this version is owed.
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step; the one spread measured is that of a small perturbation of its trajectory (the conversion change of 15d8694), which, with the cell's defect of then (fasteners thrown out of their bins, fixed in 8439170), moved mean_pack_credit from 1.00000 to 0.99440 (one pack by 2.7 %), and 0.95 leaves about nine times that. It leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that ends outside a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). The validate run on a second host (another CPU and GPU) repeated every pack's steps; it has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts. Since the third round's completion gate a pack that is not taken apart counts 0, so one pack that another host's physics left unfinished would move mean_pack_credit by a sixth (to 0.833, reward 0.877): full_at 0.95 then fails the oracle, which is meant (the reference keeps every pack far from every cliff, its margins above); a validate on another host is the check.
